'''''Anthemis arvensis''''', also known as '''corn chamomile''', '''mayweed''', '''scentless chamomile''',<ref name="ITIS">{{ITIS |id=36331 |taxon=''Anthemis arvensis'' L. |accessdate=16 June 2008}}</ref> or '''field chamomile''',<ref name="GRIN">{{GRIN | name =''Anthemis arvensis'' L. | id = 103870 | access-date = 11 April 2025 }}</ref><ref name="NRCS">{{PLANTS
|taxon=Anthemis arvensis
|symbol=ANAR6
|accessdate=2008-06-16
}}</ref> is a species of flowering plant in the [[Asteraceae|aster family]]. It is used as an [[ornamental plant]].

[[File:Anthemis arvensis02.jpg|thumb|Photo from [[Calvi, France]].]]
;Native<ref name="GRIN"/>
:;[[Palearctic]]:
::'''Macaronesia''': [[Azores]], [[Canary Islands]]
::'''Northern Africa''': [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]]
::'''Western Asia''': [[Sinai Peninsula|Sinai]], [[Iran]], [[Iraq]], [[Saudi Arabia]], [[Turkey]]
::'''Caucasus''': [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[North Caucasus]]
::'''Northern Europe''': [[Denmark]], [[Finland]], [[Ireland]], [[Norway]], [[Sweden]], [[United Kingdom]]
::'''Central Europe''': [[Austria]], [[Belgium]], [[Czech Republic]], [[Slovakia]], [[Germany]], [[Hungary]], [[Netherlands]], [[Poland]], [[Switzerland]]
::'''East Europe''': [[Belarus]], [[Moldova]], [[Ukraine]], [[Crimea]]
::'''Southeastern Europe''': [[Albania]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[Bulgaria]], [[Croatia]], [[Greece]], [[Crete]], [[Italy]], [[Montenegro]], [[North Macedonia]], [[Romania]], [[Sardinia]], [[Serbia]], [[Sicily]], [[Slovenia]]
::'''Southwestern Europe''': [[France]] [[Corsica]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], [[Balearic Islands]]

;Introduced

==Subspecies==
Six subspecies are accepted.<ref name = powo>{{cite web |title=''Anthemis arvensis'' L. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:177158-1 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] |access-date=10 February 2025}}</ref>
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''acrochordona'' {{small|Briq. & Cavill.}} – France, Italy, Sardinia
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''arvensis'' – Macaronesia, Europe, north Africa, Western Asia
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''cyllenea'' <small>(Halácsy) R.Fern.</small> – Greece including Cyclades
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''glabra'' {{small|(Rouy) Jeanm.}} – Corsica
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''incrassata'' <small>(Loisel.) Nyman</small> – Morocco and Mediterranean Europe from Portugal to Crete
* ''Anthemis arvensis'' subsp. ''sphacelata'' <small>(C.Presl) R.Fern.</small> – southern Italy and Sicily
